answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 13664 Country: Kenya Title: Assalamualikum, Is it permissable to use intrest money to build Toilet in the Madrasah? Question: Assalamualikum, Is it permissable to use intrest money to build Toilet in the Madrasah? Answer ID: 13664 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 943/943=M/1430) It is unlawful. The interest amount should be distributed in the poor without any intention of reward: لأن سبیل الکسب الخبیث التصدق (شامي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
